title: Module localization is the filtered colimit over powers
statement: Let A be a commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-module-localization], f an element of A, and M an A-module [def-weil-pbc-module-localization]. The canonical map from the filtered colimit of the directed system M \xrightarrow{f} M \xrightarrow{f} M with every transition multiplication by f to the localization M_f is an isomorphism of A-modules; the class of m at stage e maps to m/f^e.
